The career site (/ux/ats/careersite/{n}/home?c={corp}) and requisition pages are 5 KB JS shells; jobs come only from POST /services/x/career-site/v1/search with the bearer token in csod.context.token (401 without it on americares and ymca, 2026-11-08). No sitemap (/sitemap.xml 404, careersite sitemap redirects to login), legacy JobDetails.aspx/search.aspx redirect to the shell. |

Owner decision 2026-11-08: the internal host is not used, so there is no public listing. Career pages are a JS shell (sitemap.xml 403); the production app bundle sends its job search, without any token, to an Elasticsearch proxy at prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com/apply/proxy-es/{search-en-us\|search-fr-ca\|search-es-us}/posting/_search (robots.txt 404). One GET ?size=1 returned 200 with full postings (title, HTML description, address, brand, clientId/clientName, contractType, internalOrExternal; 190,608 hits in the index). The host is named internal and takes arbitrary Elasticsearch queries, so it was used for that one request only. The public site filters by clientId.raw (+ brand.raw, location.id) and, for external candidates, internalOrExternal = externalOnly. |

## Research gaps

19 todo platforms have fewer than 2 verified example boards: Artha, CSOD, CareerPlug, CareerSiteCloud, Dayforce, Dover, Freshteam, JOIN.com, JobBoardFire, Nodex, Paycom, Paycor, Talenetic, UltiPro, eJobBoard, ejobsitesoftware.com, jobBoardHQ, jobboardsoftware.com, talentReef.

"Verified" means the endpoint and examples answered a live request on that date; "no" means the entry comes from documentation or prior knowledge and must be re-checked before implementation. "Generic" = whether the generic sitemap/RSS + schema.org JobPosting approach worked on the evaluated boards (`scripts/evaluate_generic.py`).
